# POL-005 Escalation Matrix

> Fictional document for demonstration. Not a real policy.

## 1. Purpose

Defines who is informed, and how fast, when a risk, compliance or operational event occurs.

## 2. Severity definitions

| Severity | Definition | Examples |
|---|---|---|
| S1 — Critical | Regulatory breach, client-fund shortfall, trading outage > 15 min | Member-level limit breach (POL-001 §4.3); unauthorised access to client data |
| S2 — High | Breach likely without action within the day | Client at ≥ 100% limit not squared off; margin shortfall > 1 crore |
| S3 — Medium | Threshold crossed, no breach yet | Proprietary book > 35% of member limit (POL-001 §4.4); repeated 90% limit alerts |
| S4 — Low | Procedural lapse | Late daily report |

## 3. Escalation path and response times

| Severity | First notified | Within | Escalate to | Within |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| S1 | CRO, CCO, MD | 15 minutes | Board Risk Committee chair | 2 hours |
| S2 | Head of Risk, Compliance Manager | 30 minutes | CRO, CCO | 2 hours |
| S3 | Head of Risk | 1 hour | CRO | End of day |
| S4 | Compliance Manager | End of day | CCO | Weekly summary |

## 4. Regulatory reporting

S1 events shall be reported to the relevant exchange within the period prescribed by the exchange, and in any case within 24 hours.

## 5. Contact register

The on-call register is maintained by Operations and is not stored in this repository.

## 6. Review

Semi-annual review by the CCO.
